name: sarina
description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Sarina is a display typeface with brush style letterforms. Sarina's medium contrast and wide setting offers a casual breezy feeling. Sarina is appropriate for medium to larger sizes. Source files are available from Google Code . To contribute to the project contact Eben Sorkin .
